newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Realistic "fire and brimstone" at S.African church.
newsitem.headline: Realistic "fire and brimstone" at S.African church.

text.p: South African churchgoers were treated to a realistic "fire and brimstone" service on Sunday when their Calvinist theologian accidentally set off a canister of teargas while animatedly preaching against sin.
Afrikaner Dominee Ferdi Gouws was expanding on the seriousness of sin during the children's service and using aerosol sprays as props when he released the teargas, state radio reported.
The gas spread quickly through the Nederduitse Gereformeerde Kerk in Port Elizabeth's Kraggakamma suburb as the congregation rushed coughing and sneezing from the pews.
The embarrassed minister apologised but the rest of the service was marked by coughing and spluttering.
